column1:
Discounted cash flows:
The valuation model
considers the present
value of net cash flows to
be generated from the
property, taking into
account expected rental
growth rate, void periods,
occupancy rate, lease
incentive costs such as
rent-free periods and other
costs not paid by tenants.
column2:
Expected market rental
growth 5%.
Void periods 6 months at
the beginning of each
lease.
Occupancy rate 90%.
Rent-free periods 6 months
at the beginning of each
lease.
Discount rate 14%.
column3:
The estimated fair value would
increase (decrease) if:
 expected market rental growth
were higher (lower);
 void periods were shorter (longer);
 the occupancy rate was higher
(lower);
 rent-free periods were shorter
(longer); or
 the discount rate was lower
(higher).
